novel_features.name: KOL ranking
novel_features.description: Rank physicians in a specialty and region by speaking and consulting dollars, number of paying companies and years active.
novel_features.rationale: Needs nature-filtered sums and distinct-company/year counts across every synced year, which the 500-row live API cannot aggregate.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when asked who the key opinion leaders are in a specialty or territory.

novel_features.name: New recipients
novel_features.description: See which clinicians received industry payments this year for the first time, compared against every earlier synced year.
novel_features.rationale: Set difference across yearly partitions held in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when asked who is new to industry payments or which new relationships a company started.

novel_features.name: Rising relationships
novel_features.description: Find recipient-company pairs whose dollars grew the most year over year.
novel_features.rationale: Exact YoY joins across full years; competing tools only sample cross-year totals.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for 'which relationships are growing' questions.

novel_features.name: Research-site scouting
novel_features.description: Rank sites and principal investigators by research dollars, trials and sponsors for a specialty and region.
novel_features.rationale: Joins research payments, flattened PI 1-5 slots and teaching hospitals locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when scouting proven trial sites or PIs in a region.

novel_features.name: Trial gaps
novel_features.description: List recruiting trials in your region whose sponsor pays no local principal investigator. Needs network access to ClinicalTrials.gov; sponsors are matched to CMS manufacturer names by normalized text (--sponsor-alias to correct).
novel_features.rationale: Joins ClinicalTrials.gov recruiting locations with Open Payments research PIs; no single source has both.
novel_features.example: openpayments-pp-cli trials gaps --condition "low back pain" --state PA,NJ --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when looking for trials that still need local sites.

novel_features.name: Recipient compare
novel_features.description: Put two or more clinicians side by side by year, company and nature of payment.
novel_features.rationale: Pivots local payment rows per NPI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for side-by-side COI or KOL comparisons.

novel_features.name: Relationship timeline
novel_features.description: Show every company that paid a clinician with first year, last year, total and trend.
novel_features.rationale: Per-company tenure needs every synced year at once.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for how one clinician's industry relationships evolved.

novel_features.name: Trial investigators
novel_features.description: List every principal investigator paid for one ClinicalTrials.gov study, deduplicated.
novel_features.rationale: Flattens the five PI slots on every research payment into one row per PI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when asked who was paid as PI on a specific trial.

novel_features.name: Company overlap
novel_features.description: See which recipients two companies both pay, and who only one pays.
novel_features.rationale: Set intersection over locally synced recipients.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for competitive mapping between two manufacturers.

novel_features.name: Batch roster check
novel_features.description: Summarize payments for a whole list of NPIs in one pass, including disputed counts.
novel_features.rationale: Batch resolution plus aggregates from the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for conflict-of-interest reviews of many clinicians.

novel_features.name: Agent question helper
novel_features.description: Print the local schema, a plain-word glossary and worked SQL examples for any question.
novel_features.rationale: Introspects the local SQLite store; no LLM embedded.
novel_features.example: openpayments-pp-cli ask "top companies paying PA pain doctors"
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when no dedicated command fits and you need to write SQL.

novel_features.name: Spend concentration
novel_features.description: Measure how concentrated a company's spend is: top-10 share, HHI and recipients to reach 50% and 80%.
novel_features.rationale: Arithmetic over a company's full local spend distribution.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for questions about how concentrated a company's payments are.

novel_features.name: Radius search
novel_features.description: Find paid clinicians within N miles of a ZIP code (ZIP-centroid distance).
novel_features.rationale: Haversine over a bundled ZIP centroid table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for geographic questions around a ZIP.

novel_features.name: Change detection
novel_features.description: See records added, corrected or removed by the latest re-sync (needs at least two syncs of the same scope).
novel_features.rationale: Diffs each sync against the local store and CMS change_type.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after a CMS refresh to see what moved.

novel_features.name: Cooling relationships
novel_features.description: Find recipient-company pairs whose dollars fell or stopped year over year.
novel_features.rationale: Same exact YoY join as rising, sorted the other way.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for 'which relationships are cooling' questions.

novel_features.name: Sponsor trial map
novel_features.description: Show a sponsor's ClinicalTrials.gov trials with the sites it already pays. Needs network access to ClinicalTrials.gov; sponsors are matched to CMS manufacturer names by normalized text (--sponsor-alias to correct).
novel_features.rationale: Joins ClinicalTrials.gov lead-sponsor trials to local research payments by NCT.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for one sponsor's trial portfolio.

narrative.headline: A local, exact, offline map of who industry pays: every CMS Open Payments dataset, plus KOL rankings, new and rising relationships, and trial-site gaps computed from synced data.
narrative.value_prop: Sync the payments you care about (by state, specialty, NPI or company) into typed SQLite and answer dossier, leaderboard and year-over-year questions locally. Commands like kol, rising, research-sites and trials gaps join General, Research and Ownership data with ClinicalTrials.gov, with provenance on every row.
narrative.auth_narrative: No API key or account is needed. CMS Open Payments and ClinicalTrials.gov are public, unauthenticated APIs. The CLI paces itself (4 requests per second, 4 workers by default) to stay polite to CMS.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the CLI is installed; no network needed
See the current dataset IDs CMS publishes for a program year
Pull a scoped slice into the local store (the plan's seed)
Rank key opinion leaders by speaking and consulting dollars

troubleshoots.symptom: A live query fails with 'JSON Schema validation failed'
troubleshoots.fix: The DKAN API caps pages at 500 rows; use --limit 500 or less (the CLI paginates for you)
Run sync for the scope first, e.g. openpayments-pp-cli sync --years 2024 --states PA

troubleshoots.symptom: Name or company filter is slow on live data
troubleshoots.fix: Live wildcard filters take ~30 s on 15M-row years; sync the scope and query locally instead

troubleshoots.symptom: Dataset ID not found after a CMS refresh
troubleshoots.fix: Run openpayments-pp-cli datasets resolve --refresh; IDs change every June and January

troubleshoots.symptom: dossier/relationships says 'no match' for an NPI
troubleshoots.fix: The NPI is outside the synced scope; run openpayments-pp-cli sync --years 2019-2025 --npi <NPI>

troubleshoots.symptom: trials gaps marks a trial as a gap you know is covered
troubleshoots.fix: Sponsor names are matched to CMS manufacturer names by normalized text; pass --sponsor-alias "CT sponsor=CMS name" and sync the region's research payments

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to answer factual questions about industry payments to US physicians, non-physician practitioners and teaching hospitals from CMS Open Payments (2019-2025): dossiers, company footprints, leaderboards, year-over-year relationship changes, research payments by trial, and trial-site gaps joined with ClinicalTrials.gov.
anti_triggers: Do not use it to judge whether a payment was improper or a clinician is conflicted; it reports published facts only
Do not use it to find personal contact details; only published business addresses are available
Do not use it for prescribing data (Medicare Part D) or non-US payments
Do not use it to modify CMS data; the API is read-only

recipes.title: Sync a scope
recipes.explanation: Every local command reads synced data; scope by --states, --specialty, --npi or --company (or --full --bulk --year 2024 --type research for a bulk CSV).

recipes.title: Top PA recipients
recipes.explanation: Top 20 PA recipients by total general payments, narrowed to three fields.

recipes.title: Clinician dossier
recipes.explanation: Totals by year, company, nature and product with disputed-payment counts for one NPI; add --payments N for individual rows.

recipes.title: PIs on one trial
recipes.explanation: Every principal investigator Open Payments shows was paid for that study.

recipes.title: Trial gaps
recipes.command: openpayments-pp-cli trials gaps --condition "low back pain" --state PA,NJ --agent
recipes.explanation: Recruiting trials in PA/NJ whose sponsor pays no local PI.

recipes.title: Custom SQL
recipes.command: openpayments-pp-cli sql "SELECT company, SUM(amount) total FROM payments_general WHERE state='PA' GROUP BY company ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10" --agent
recipes.explanation: Write your own query after reading schema --json.

trigger_phrases: which PIs were paid for this trial
key opinion leaders in pain medicine
new or rising industry payment relationships
recruiting trials that need local sites
